about: Profile `bell`: a KeyInput with NO features and NO attributes — the doorbell from types/0x0010-key-input.md §1. The core alone: Click(1) on release, however long the press. An element of the type outside the declared features answers UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE; one the type does not know, or an optional one not exposed, UNSUPPORTED_ELEMENT (04-interakcje.md §9). Response header = result << 3 | Tid.

steps.note: a second held, and no hold — the bell has no HOLD
one Click, however long the press
EventMode: an element of the type, feature not declared
PressCount: optional, not feature-bound, not exposed
0x10 was DebounceTime and is no element of the type now
